questions.question: Why does communalism pose a fundamental threat to the spirit of a plural democratic nation like India?
options: It promotes higher voter turnout in rural constituencies
It encourages international commercial shipping
It requires all citizens to learn Sanskrit and Urdu
It assumes that people of different religions cannot live together as equal citizens within one nation and fosters mutual hatred
questions.explanation: Communalism is based on the flawed assumption that religious differences are the primary social divide and that people of different faiths have conflicting political interests, which destroys democratic fraternity.

questions.subtopic: Positive Role of Caste in Politics
questions.question: In what way can the political expression of caste play a positive and healthy role in a developing democracy?
options: It allows historically disadvantaged and backward castes to demand their legitimate share of power, dignity, and access to resources
It ensures that only upper-caste landlords hold ministerial portfolios
It abolishes all competitive entrance examinations permanently
It prevents regional parties from contesting national elections
questions.explanation: Caste politics has helped people from Dalits and OBC castes to gain better access to decision making. Several political and non-political organisations have been demanding and agitating for an end to discrimination, for more dignity and more access to land, resources and opportunities.
